newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down sharply on Lujiazui.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down sharply on Lujiazui.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended sharply down on Monday due to heavy profit-taking in property developer Lujiazui after the listing of its four-for-10 bonus issue shares today, brokers said.
The index fell 2.922 points or 4.52 percent to 61.781 points, on volume of 13.2 million shares worth $6.2 million against $6.6 million last Friday.
Market barometer Lujiazui continued to be the most active share, falling $0.072 or 7.89 percent to $0.840 on volume of 3.1 million shares.
Brokers said that heavy profit-taking selling in Lujiazui worsened market sentiment and sent the index down consecutively.
"There was no sign that Lujiazui would stop falling in the short term and most investors had no interest in building positions," one broker said.
"The key 63-point support level has been breached," a second broker said. "The index is likely to test the next 58-point level in the next few sessions."
All 42 B shares traded, with 39 down and three up.
Industrial Sewing Machine was the biggest loser on expectations of poor results, plunging limit-down 10 percent or $0.018 to $0.160 on volume of 97,000 shares.
The Shanghai A share market also fell sharply on weaker market sentiment, and it was expected to drop further in the short term, brokers said.

The A index closed down 23.520 points or 2.51 percent to 913.841 points, on volume of 205.4 million shares worth 1.8 billion yuan. The SSE 30 index fell 55.552 points or 2.31 percent to 2350.645 points.
Dongfang Boiler was the biggest loser on profit-taking, tumbling 0.97 yuan or 9.35 percent to 9.40 yuan on volume of 6.7 million shares.
